title: FMLA Eligibility and Leave Entitlement Determination
brief: A policy interpretation memo regarding an employee's request for Family and Medical Leave Act (FMLA) leave, drafted from company payroll and attendance records.

slip.document:
# FMLA Eligibility and Leave Entitlement Determination
Human Resources Department - Pinewood Logistics LLC

## Employee Information
- Employee Name: Caleb Navarro
- Position: Dispatch Coordinator
- Hire Date: 03/15/2023
- Leave Request Date: 04/06/2026
- Requested Leave Period: 04/20/2026 to 06/12/2026 (8 weeks)
- Qualifying Reason: Serious health condition (inpatient orthopedic surgery)

## Statutory Eligibility Review
| Criterion | Requirement | Employee Record | Status |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Service Length | At least 12 months | 36 months | Satisfied |
| Hours Worked | 1,250 hours in prior 12 mos | 1,380 hours | Satisfied |
| Worksite Size | 50+ staff within 75 miles | 82 employees | Satisfied |

Caleb Navarro meets all baseline criteria under the federal Family and Medical Leave Act (29 CFR Part 825) as of the requested start date.

## Prior FMLA Usage (Rolling 12-Month Period: 04/20/2025 - 04/19/2026)
| Date Range | Leave Type | Weeks Used |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 08/11/2025 - 08/29/2025 | Intermittent / Personal Health | 3.0 |
| 11/17/2025 - 11/28/2025 | Continuous / Care of Spouse | 2.0 |

## Available Entitlement Calculation
Pinewood Logistics calculates FMLA leave using a rolling 12-month period measured backward from the date an employee uses any leave.

- Statutory maximum annual entitlement: 12.0 weeks
- Previous leave deducted: 5.0 weeks
- The remaining available balance for the requested leave is 8.0 weeks

Because the requested continuous leave duration is 8.0 weeks, the requested duration exceeds the employee's available balance under this policy.

## Benefits and Health Coverage Rules
Caleb Navarro currently maintains individual major medical coverage through the company group plan at an employee contribution rate of $120.00 per semi-monthly pay period.

Under federal FMLA compliance standards, the employer will discontinue group health insurance benefits during any unpaid portion of FMLA leave.

Upon return to work on 06/15/2026, the employee will be reinstated to the same position or an equivalent position with equivalent employment benefits, pay, and terms pursuant to 29 CFR 825.214.

errors.quote: remaining available balance for the requested leave is 8.0 weeks
errors.explanation: Subtracting 5.0 weeks of prior leave used from the statutory 12.0 weeks leaves 7.0 weeks, not 8.0 weeks.
errors.fix: remaining available balance for the requested leave is 7.0 weeks

errors.quote: the employer will discontinue group health insurance benefits during any unpaid portion of FMLA leave
errors.explanation: Under 29 U.S.C. 2614(c)(1) and 29 CFR 825.209, employers are legally required to maintain group health insurance coverage for an employee on FMLA leave under the same conditions as if the employee had continued working.
errors.fix: the employer must maintain group health insurance benefits during any unpaid portion of FMLA leave
